bio: Feya Marble Arch features a glistening ‘Hand of Inspiration’ installation that hangs from the ceiling and illuminates the space.  Ramona Pintea has curated two unique murals inspired by Women Empowerment, so guests can expect an exquisite, one stop visionary experience.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes Smoked Salmon Roulade with Mango Cheese, Feta Cheese & Pistachio Bites and Mushroom & Broccoli Vol au Vent. A selection of mini patisserie is served with freshly baked scones, accompanied by jams and clotted cream.  Choose from a selection of premium teas, including English Breakfast, Earl Grey and Green Jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 12pm to 6pm and costs £37.50 per person.  Feya Marble Arch is located just off Marble Arch corner, close to Hyde Park and Edgeware Road.
